findings.title: c2 overwrites concurrent unrelated crontab changes and reports success
findings.finding: c2 reads the full crontab once, builds W/cand, performs other checks/consumption, then installs the entire stale candidate. It never compare-and-swaps the live scheduler before-image under a common writer transaction. Readback compares against its own stale candidate, so it certifies lost unrelated edits. This is an existing packet weakness, not introduced by finite-grant accounting, but the newly registered campaign action remains executable and cannot be approved for production under the campaign contract.
findings.reproduction: test_tune_c2_preserves_operator_edit_between_read_and_install: fake crontab appends an unrelated operator comment immediately before install; packet exits0 installed byte-exact and comment is lost.
findings.required_change: Route through the shared reconciliable exact-entry scheduler controller with durable before-image/CAS/journal/compensation and coordinated writer locking. Until that path is reviewed, fail closed before grant consumption/effect for this legacy c2 action. Do not restore a stale whole crontab.
findings.mandate: §5 scheduler handover; §8 exact concurrent-edit preservation and one controller for manual/scheduled actions

findings.title: Legacy owner changes/rollback bypass the required drain-and-reconcile transaction
findings.finding: Tune and feedback c3/rollback call effect_claim set-owner after a wall-clock quiet-window check, grant validation and framework check. Neither inspects REQUESTED/RUNNING work or held/UNKNOWN effects, pauses admission, waits for drain, nor journals workflow/live-list/owner agreement. set_owner_with_manifest serializes admission/claim/spawn ordering, but its handover lock is released while the spawned child runs; it does not drain and these Hermes lanes are not among the3 late-write-fenced lanes. A scoped grant cannot substitute for those required preconditions. Existing weakness remains; these legacy mutations must not be presented as eligible campaign cutover or rollback.
findings.required_change: Use the common transactional controller and exact reviewed runtime state; otherwise hard-hold these registered owner/rollback actions before consumption. Add admitted/claimed/spawned child, UNKNOWN effect and rollback race tests.
evidence: Source inspection of complete grant candidate packet/EffectClaimStore/gated_run paths; no production owner switch attempted
findings.mandate: §8 steps2,3,6; no UNKNOWN expiry; epochs monotonic; activation grant does not widen action safety

findings.title: Caller-computed hashes and a producer label can authenticate arbitrary coverage
findings.finding: The CLI obtains --coverage-sha256 and --evidence-root from its caller, checks a referenced JSON hash supplied inside coverage, but never authenticates a host producer or validates the source report content against the lane/campaign/freeze/interval/coverage/findings. The source can be{}, while caller fields continuous=true,complete=true and empty finding lists establish eligibility. Pure evaluate_retirement may reasonably require authenticated input from a caller, but this public CLI is the stated trust boundary and does not supply that authentication. Current docstring saying no n8n/LLM-provided coverage is accepted is unsupported.
findings.reproduction: test_cli_unrelated_source_json_does_not_authenticate_interval_coverage: replace referenced host report with{}, recompute caller-controlled hashes, retain valid fake live host world; CLI returns deletion_eligible.
findings.required_change: Wire an existing trusted host collector/attestation verifier and pin its authenticated provenance/key or protected canonical receipt source, then validate exact source schema, lane/campaign/freeze/release, interval and source coverage/findings. Refuse unsupported/unavailable producer verification; a digest alone provides integrity, not producer identity or coverage semantics.
findings.mandate: §4 evidence contracts attestation provenance; §6 daily host attestations; §8 continuous qualifying observation cannot be self-asserted

findings.title: A nonexistent rollback_ref satisfies eligibility
findings.finding: retirement_problems validates rollback_ref only as a nonempty string. retirement_report reads and binds the legacy before-image and source-report files but never reads/verifies rollback_ref. The supplied fixture has no tested-rollback.json at all, yet becomes deletion_eligible. Thus tested rollback is omitted from eligibility evidence.
findings.reproduction: test_cli_missing_tested_rollback_receipt_cannot_qualify confirms nonexistent rollback artifact, then CLI still returns deletion_eligible.
findings.required_change: Resolve and digest-bind a real supported rollback/canary receipt under the trusted evidence root; verify successful tested rollback, identities/config/workflow/controller version, fresh monotonic epoch semantics and required readbacks. Missing/unverifiable/mismatched rollback proof must hold.
findings.mandate: §8 rollback_ref is a tested rollback receipt; retirement eligibility requires all active proof requirements

findings.title: Unbound NYSE calendar removes missed daily weekend slots
findings.finding: The frozen schedule is checked only for cron and tz agreement. calendar can be nyse while the effective daily lane has market_gate=false. _retirement_slots then omits weekend fires and the evaluator qualifies two weekday receipts over a4-day interval despite two missed daily weekend runs. Freeze hashes bind the chosen label, but do not prove it agrees with active scheduling/health policy.
findings.reproduction: test_nyse_label_cannot_hide_missed_ungated_daily_weekend_slots: ungated10 6 * * * lane, Thu-to-Mon coverage, only Fri/Mon receipts, calendar=nyse => deletion_eligible.
findings.required_change: Derive and validate the effective lane calendar from registered schedule/market-gate/health contract and require exact freeze agreement; count all natural slots actually due. Preserve authorized per-lane calendar exemptions with explicit reviewed contract, not a free coverage field.
findings.mandate: §4 health/readiness natural schedule; §8 no missed slots, DST/market-calendar eligibility tests
